aliases: casefolded bare IDs; canonical input/schema hash invariant to function order and standalone function-name renaming (names mechanically replaced by schema-rank tokens)
eligibility: at most six scalar parameters per function
exposure_exclusions: all historical DEV function names/families plus native multiple_0 triangle/circle families and bare-ID/input-schema duplicate aliases
revision_reason: Initial additional two-per-component constraint caused HOLD despite29 records/27 components; removed only that extra constraint before any labels or predictions.
selection: Hash-rank eligible records; take the lowest-ranked record from each of the first three eligible unexposed family components, then the lowest-ranked remaining records globally until six. All decisions use inputs only. At least three components required; no outcomes, baseline or gold consulted.
unsupported_after_freeze: score errors/abstentions as zero and retain IDs; never drop or replace
